description: Tencent AuK base and AuK-Flash speech generation and editing models.

request.name: instruct
request.description: TTS voice description. Without it, text carries the complete upstream instruction; editing instructions always go in text.

request.name: duration_sec
request.description: Positive output duration in seconds. Required without reference audio; otherwise defaults to the valid reference duration.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Euler sampling steps for AuK base; AuK-Flash always uses its fixed four-step schedule.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Batched guidance strength for AuK base; AuK-Flash always disables classifier-free guidance.

request.name: seed
request.description: Nonnegative noise seed, or -1 for a random seed.

session.name: variant
session.description: AuK generation schedule; select flash with an AuK-Flash component.

session.name: model_gguf
session.description: AuK base or Flash generator GGUF relative to the model root; defaults to the selected variant's F32 file.

session.name: qwen_gguf
session.description: Qwen2.5-Omni-3B conditioning GGUF relative to the model root.

session.name: vae_gguf
session.description: AuK VAE GGUF relative to the model root.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release Qwen conditioning and generation weights between stages to reduce peak VRAM.

description.en: Tencent AuK base and AuK-Flash speech generation and editing models.
description.zh: 腾讯 AuK 与 AuK-Flash 语音生成与编辑模型。

instruct.en: TTS voice description. Without it, text carries the complete upstream instruction; editing instructions always go in text.
instruct.zh: TTS 音色描述。不填时由文本承载完整的上游指令；编辑类指令始终写在文本里。

duration_sec.en: Positive output duration in seconds. Required without reference audio; otherwise defaults to the valid reference duration.
duration_sec.zh: 输出时长（秒，正数）。无参考音频时必填；否则默认为有效参考时长。

num_inference_steps.en: Euler sampling steps for AuK base; AuK-Flash always uses its fixed four-step schedule.
num_inference_steps.zh: AuK base 的 Euler 采样步数；AuK-Flash 固定使用其四步调度。

guidance_scale.en: Batched guidance strength for AuK base; AuK-Flash always disables classifier-free guidance.
guidance_scale.zh: AuK base 的批处理引导强度；AuK-Flash 始终关闭无分类器引导。

seed.en: Nonnegative noise seed, or -1 for a random seed.
seed.zh: 非负噪声随机种子；-1 表示随机。
